The '''WGF Veteran''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Vectron]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Vectron WGF Veteran was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[April 16]], [[2015]]. It was released on the in-game Cartel Market at the price of 1,800 Cartel Coins, and is the first mount to feature a "flourish"&mdash;pressing CTRL+Z triggers an animation where the engine covers open and release a burst of smoke and engine fire.
